description: This file defines the LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration class, which implements configuration interfaces for the LDAP authentication plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up logging, registers LDAP synchronization commands, and schedules LDAP synchronization jobs based on settings.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the LDAP authentication plugin, implementing plugin registration, command registration, and scheduling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes LDAP plugin, sets up logger, and registers LDAP provider if enabled.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers LDAP sync command with the console.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules LDAP sync job if LDAP is enabled, with interval based on settings.
